items.title: Dermalogica Hydro Masque Exfoliant Review: Bamboo and Snow Mushroom, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Hydro Masque Exfoliant: a five-minute masque that exfoliates with bamboo and hydrates with snow mushroom, for luminous, healthy-looking skin.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Hydro Masque Exfoliant: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Five-minute masque that exfoliates and hydrates (50 ml)
Exfoliating bamboo primes skin for hydration
Snow mushroom hydrates; jojoba esters and amino acids from sugar beets help strengthen the moisture barrier
Cucumber extract gives a soothing finish
Apply generously to cleansed face and neck, avoid eyes, massage until the spheres disappear, leave 3-5 minutes, rinse, follow with moisturizer; once or twice a week

scenes.caption: Hydro Masque Exfoliant
scenes.say: Want to exfoliate without leaving your skin feeling dry? In this review, we look at the Dermalogica Hydro Masque Exfoliant: what it is, what's in it, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: Five-minute masque
scenes.say: It's a five-minute masque that does two jobs at once. It exfoliates, and it hydrates. The result it's made for is luminous, healthy-looking skin.

scenes.caption: Exfoliating bamboo
scenes.say: The exfoliating part comes from bamboo. Exfoliating bamboo smooths the skin and primes it for hydration, so what comes next can do its job. It's the exfoliating half of this two-in-one masque.

scenes.caption: Snow mushroom
scenes.say: The hydrating part comes from snow mushroom. Snow mushroom is the hydrator in this masque, alongside sodium hyaluronate and glycerin in the ingredient list.

scenes.caption: Jojoba esters
scenes.say: Jojoba esters and amino acids from sugar beets help strengthen your skin's moisture barrier.

scenes.caption: Cucumber extract
scenes.say: And cucumber extract gives a soothing finish, so your skin feels calm when you rinse it off.

scenes.caption: Quick recap
scenes.say: So, a quick recap of what's inside. Bamboo to exfoliate. Snow mushroom and sodium hyaluronate to hydrate. Jojoba esters and amino acids from sugar beets for the moisture barrier. And cucumber extract for a soothing finish. Every one of those is named in the product description.

scenes.caption: Start with clean skin
scenes.say: Here's how to use it. Start with a cleansed face. Then apply the masque generously over your face and neck, avoiding the eye area.

scenes.caption: Massage in circles
scenes.say: Massage it in using circular motions, until the little spheres in the formula disappear. That massage is part of how it exfoliates.

scenes.caption: Leave on 3 to 5 minutes
scenes.say: Leave it on for three to five minutes. That's why it's called a five-minute masque. It fits into a busy evening.

scenes.caption: Rinse thoroughly
scenes.say: Then rinse thoroughly with water, and pat your skin dry.

scenes.caption: Follow with moisturizer
scenes.say: Follow with your moisturizer, to seal in the hydration.

scenes.caption: Once or twice a week
scenes.say: Use it once or twice a week. The ingredient list can change, so check the packaging for the current list. If your skin feels dull and dry, this masque exfoliates and hydrates in five minutes. The link is in the description.

items.lead: Dermalogica BioLumin-C Night Restore Serum: an overnight serum with ultra-stable vitamin C and pro-vitamin D that helps repair the moisture barrier while you sleep, for dehydration, hyperpigmentation and lackluster skin.
items.hook: The Dermalogica BioLumin-C Night Restore Serum: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Overnight serum with ultra-stable vitamin C and pro-vitamin D (25 ml)
Helps repair and restore the moisture barrier during sleep
Long-lasting brightness and immediate hydration; helps reverse daytime damage
For dehydration, hyperpigmentation, lackluster skin and a damaged moisture barrier
After cleansing and toning, 3-4 drops over face and neck before bed, before moisturizer; keep out of eyes
Sensitive skin can use it; patch test first if you know of a specific sensitivity; no artificial fragrance

scenes.caption: BioLumin-C Night Restore
scenes.say: Does your skin look tired and dull by the end of the day? In this review, we look at the Dermalogica BioLumin-C Night Restore Serum: what it is, what's in it, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: Overnight serum
scenes.say: It's an overnight serum with ultra-stable vitamin C and pro-vitamin D. It works while you sleep, to help repair your skin's moisture barrier. That's why you use it at night, as the last serum before bed.

scenes.caption: Vitamin C
scenes.say: Vitamin C is the star here. In the ingredient list it appears as aminopropyl ascorbyl phosphate, a vitamin C derivative. The serum gives long-lasting brightness and immediate hydration.

scenes.caption: Pro-vitamin D
scenes.say: Pro-vitamin D is the other half of the name. Together, the formula helps repair and restore the skin's moisture barrier, and helps reverse daytime damage.

scenes.caption: What's inside
scenes.say: The ingredient list also includes tranexamic acid, ergothioneine, glycerin, jojoba esters, squalane and tocopherol.

scenes.caption: Who it's for
scenes.say: Who is it for? Skin with dehydration, hyperpigmentation, lackluster skin, and a damaged moisture barrier.

scenes.caption: Rich, silky texture
scenes.say: The texture is a rich, silky serum that absorbs quickly and is generally non-sticky.

scenes.caption: Quick recap
scenes.say: So, a quick recap. It's a night serum with ultra-stable vitamin C and pro-vitamin D. It gives long-lasting brightness and immediate hydration, helps repair and restore the moisture barrier, and helps reverse daytime damage, all while you sleep.

scenes.caption: Cleanse and tone
scenes.say: Here's how to use it. At night, cleanse and tone first.

scenes.caption: 3 to 4 drops
scenes.say: Then dispense three to four drops, and apply evenly over your face and neck before bed. Keep it out of your eyes.

scenes.caption: Then moisturizer
scenes.say: Layering is simple: apply it after your toner, and before your moisturizer.

scenes.caption: Sensitive skin
scenes.say: People with sensitive skin can use it. If you know you're sensitive to a specific ingredient, patch test first.

scenes.caption: No artificial fragrance
scenes.say: It has no artificial fragrances, though the botanicals may have a natural scent. If you want brightness, hydration and barrier repair in one night-time step, this is the serum to look at. The link is in the description.
